blurb: Guests can join guided kayak tours along Vancouver's beaches, participate in private or group kayaking lessons, or attend skill progression clinics. Tours include the Jericho Explorer and Sunset Kayak tours with opportunities to see wildlife and city views. Lessons range from private customized sessions to Paddle Canada Level 2 certification courses.
extraNote: 25% deposit required to confirm group bookings · Full refund if cancellation made at least 14 days before program · Cancellations less than 14 days forfeit deposit · All programs run rain or shine · Booking fee of $10 per participant for group number changes exceeding 25% · Jericho Beach Kayak hut at Jericho Beach
